chapter: Hippolyte Charles, the bass and other bands
title: Tom Mitchell, trumpeter Mutt Carter and the Cashman brothers
summary: Dawson plays through who Tom Mitchell played bass with, finally recalling the trumpeter Mutt Carter, whose band included John Cashman and Dawson on guitar.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Bass players: lineage, tone and technique
